display_name: Refrigeration or Air-Conditioning Systems Work Licensing Law 5785-2025 (Israel), with its Fees Regulations
title_native: חוק הסדרת העיסוק בעבודה במערכת קירור או מיזוג אוויר, התשפ״ה–2025
citation: Regulation of Engagement in Work on Refrigeration or Air-Conditioning Systems Law 5785-2025, Sefer HaChukim 3349 p. 182 (14 January 2025); and the Regulation of Engagement in Work on Refrigeration or Air-Conditioning Systems (Fees) Regulations 5785-2025, Kovetz HaTakanot 5785 p. 2116 (published 9 July 2025, in force 16 July 2025), as amended by Kovetz HaTakanot 5786 p. 2062
authority: The Knesset (the Law); the Minister of Labour with the approval of the Knesset Labour and Welfare Committee, under ss. 59-60 of the Law (the Regulations)

source.note: The consolidated Hebrew text of both instruments was read from ספר החוקים הפתוח on Hebrew Wikisource, a volunteer project maintained by OpenLawBot; source/revisions.json records the exact revision ids deposited (Law: rev 2947808 of 2025-07-10; Regulations: rev 3011135 of 2026-05-04, which already carries the 5786 amendment). Wikisource is NOT an official source. The official gazette issue, Sefer HaChukim 3349, is deposited beside it as a PDF served by gov.il, as is the bill as tabled for second and third reading; the encoding was checked against the gazette text for every section it encodes. reshumot.justice.gov.il, the official gazette site, is geo-blocked outside Israel and was not consulted.

why_this_subject: Figure 4 of Elhanan Schwartz, Ittai Bar-Siman-Tov & Roy Gelbard, When Computers Speak Laws: Legislative Engineering in the Age of Artificial Intelligence, 8 Law, Society and Culture 353 (2025), is a screen capture of the Israeli Ministry of Justice's SimpLEX drafting-and-testing tool editing the DRAFT Fees Regulations under this Law, with a four-row table of test scenarios beside the text. This subject encodes that draft, the Regulations as made, and the Regulations as amended, and runs the paper's own test table against all three -- three of its four expectations no longer held on the day the Regulations were made.
